groups.rationale: The Phase III ASCENT efficacy readout and the separate FDA Trodelvy regulatory decision are distinct material catalysts even though they concern the same issuer/asset program.
These AXS-05 events concern different clinical programs/indications and are not the same underlying dataset.

The later ASCO Tivdak disclosure may reuse or update the INNOVATV301 pivotal dataset. The conference row must not be counted separately until the abstract/presentation is compared with the earlier first-public pivotal result.
BROOKLYN and BROADWAY are separate pivotal studies and may be retained as distinct events if their individual first-public disclosures and other promotion requirements are verified.
RETHINK-ALZ and REFOCUS-ALZ are separate Phase III trials with separate result disclosures.

Annual ASH MP0533 disclosures may represent longitudinal updates of the same early clinical program. Each may only be retained if it contains a separately material dataset first made public at that event and satisfies the frozen conference-event definition.
